registry_schema.text: This is a Phase II clinical trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of a new treatment approach for patients with locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) that has spread to lymph nodes on the opposite side of the chest (known as N3 lymph node involvement).
